description: When BAS is reachable and the scenario UI is up, ui-health drives a real browser over Connect-RPC to validate the handshake, storage-shim, console errors, asset/proxy load, theme application, axe/WCAG, shortcut relay, and spatial focus. This runtime/render validation replaces the test-genie native `smoke` phase.

requirements.description: When BAS is reachable and the scenario UI is running, ui-health must drive a real browser via BAS over Connect-RPC, resolved through discovery, to validate the handshake, storage-shim, console errors, asset/proxy load, theme application, axe/WCAG, shortcut relay, and spatial focus, emitting Findings under the runtime/render check group.
requirements.title: Runtime checks run via BAS over discovery
